name: help
description: Show Superagent commands and their scope.

name: head
description: Send a request to the global Superagent coordination session.
text: Request for the global head, for example to compare two work topics.

name: status
description: Inspect Superagent HEAD and this conversation's lane, including while busy.

name: restart
description: Interrupt HEAD work and restart Superagent Gateway and HEAD with the same session and memory.

name: context
description: Inspect Superagent HEAD context without starting a model turn.

name: usage
description: Show Superagent's OMP quotas or open the saved reset picker.
text: Omit to view quotas, or enter reset to choose an account and confirm using one saved reset.

name: cron
description: Schedule and manage Superagent jobs in this conversation.
text: Use help, add, list, show, edit, pause, resume, run or remove.

name: resume
description: Resume the Superagent lane bound to this conversation.

name: resolve
description: Close an uncertain Superagent HEAD or bound lane input without replay.
text: Exact uncertain HEAD input ID, or --lane followed by the bound lane's exact input ID.

name: main
description: Select the main Superagent topic in this owner DM.

name: model
description: Choose a Superagent HEAD model, or inspect or apply a named preset.
text: Omit for the menu, or enter list, an exact provider/model, or a preset command.

name: effort
description: Choose the Superagent HEAD thinking effort.
text: Omit for the menu, or enter an exact advertised effort level.

name: compact
description: Compact Superagent HEAD context when idle.
text: Optional compaction instructions, including multiple lines.

name: stop
description: Stop Superagent work in this conversation, the shared HEAD, or a named lane.
text: Omit for this conversation, or specify head or an exact lane ID.

name: new
description: Start a Superagent work topic; use a sibling for a new request in an existing thread.
text: An optional first request for the new topic.
